newsitem.title: USA: Life USA Holding buys stake in firm.
newsitem.headline: Life USA Holding buys stake in firm.

text.p: Life USA Holding Inc said Tuesday it has acquired a minority interest in Ann Arbor Annuity Exchange, a national annuity marketing company based in Ann Arbor, Mich.. Terms were not disclosed.

Ann Arbor Annuity markets the annuity products of several companies to an independent agent base of some 30,000 agents, and has produced over $175 million of annuity premiums during the past 12 months.

As part of the agreement, Life USA has contributed additional working capital to Ann Arbor Annuity Exchange. The funds will be used by Ann Arbor to support a major marketing effort for LifeUSA Insurance and for the continued growth of the company.

While Ann Arbor Annuity Exchange has been previously contracted with LifeUSA, production has been minimal. Under the new arrangement, that situation is expected to change dramatically, Life USA said in a news release.

Ann Arbor is the fourth marketing organization to become an affiliate of Life USA in the past year. The combined premium production of these organizations is close to $700 million. Life USA is a national financial services holding and marketing company.
